findings.issue: Both arms of the if end in a revert, so the minting, Transfer event and return printed after them are unreachable, and they use variables (_1684, _1686, _1688, _1689) that are defined nowhere in the function. The reader is told the join mints BPT and returns, which no path of this bytecode does (with the zero immutables every join reverts).
findings.rule: A block all of whose predecessors end in revert, return or stop is unreachable: do not print it. Any use of an SSA name without a definition on a printed path means its defining path was pruned; the use must be pruned with it.
